oracle: Real Chrome render through Pirc Markdown enhancement and pinned Mermaid. SVG DOM text, shapes, computed styles and geometry, plus the actual C4 DB after renderer layout are recorded. Per-item wrapState preserves undefined separately from c4.wrap renderer config. Node DOMPurify stubs are not used in this browser capture.

rendererConfig.theme: base for light and dark for dark, selected by the actual Pirc matchMedia path
rendererConfig.c4Wrap: true in Pirc Mermaid renderer config; item wrap comes from the separate top-level Mermaid wrap setting and is undefined for these sources.
rendererConfig.screen: Playwright screen emulation uses the same CSS width and height as the viewport; each capture records measured screen and availWidth.
